Disposition 
- Refer Surgery depending on cause 
Definitions 
•
Crush Injury: physical injury from prolonged compression. May be 
due to direct effect of trauma or ischaemia related to compression. 
•
Crush Syndrome: systemic manifestations resulting from crush 
injury, i.e. rhabdomyolysis leading to acute kidney injury, 
multisystem organ injury or death. 
 
CRUSH INJURY & SYNDROME 
(RHABDOMYOLYSIS) 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Indications for dialysis 
* Refractory acidosis 
* Refractory hyperkalaemia 
*
 
*
 
*
 
 
Clinical Examination 
* Tramline bruising 
* Tense, oedematous, painful muscle groups 
* Dark / tea-coloured urine 
* Circulatory shock 
Investigations 
* Blood gas – metabolic acidosis (bicarb < 20, 
pH < 7.3,  lactate 
* U-dipstix – haemoglobin / protein 
* eFAST 
* Bloods: Creatinine kinase, U&E, CMP 
* No indication for repeat CK/trending of levels 
 
Causes 
Extensive soft tissue trauma 
- Community assault 
- Sjambok injury
